title: Architecture Contour Duo
body: Infused with light-diffusing pearls, the lightweight formula blends seamlessly into the skin. Use the darker shade for depth, the lighter shade to enhance high points or combine both to customize intensity. The duo can also be used as cheek color and to warm up the complexion.

title: Tobacco Vanille Parfum
body:
A parfum that amplifies the enduring legacy of Tobacco Vanille. Amber, spice and orange bitter nuances are reinvigorated with the introduction of fine oakwood extract and the smooth depth of a whiskey cask accord.

“Tobacco Vanille Parfum heightens the intensity and nobility of the original eau de parfum. Through technical advancements in perfumery and ingredient innovation, we were able to enhance a TOM FORD icon, making it more daring and more contemporary. The introduction of oakwood extract and whiskey cask accord, along with the increased dosage of Ambrofix™, lends magnified woody, spicy and amber nuance. This parfum is undeniably, addictively, TOM FORD.” – Rodrigo Flores-Roux and Shyamala Maisondieu, Perfumers

title: Tobacco Chocolat Eau de Parfum
body:
An amber gourmand fragrance that features the exclusive cocoa smoke™ accord, a co-distillation that melds the scents of rich, addictive cocoa and earthy tobacco with the bright citrus light of orange essence.
“Tobacco Chocolat is a fantasy for the senses. Smooth and cognac like, the scent is a blend of precious tobacco and dark chocolate notes, tinged with a honey-like gleam. The fragrance elevates gourmand notes to new heights, offering a sensorial experience that is rich and spicy — an exultation of scent and taste.” – Daniela Andrier, Perfumer

title: Soleil Blanc Eau de Parfum
body: This sultry solar floral amber scent evokes remote private islands where summer lasts all year and one day seamlessly blends into the next. Alive with seductive cardamom and refreshingly decadent ylang ylang, Soleil Blanc unapologetically exudes the endless pursuit of sun and luxury.

title: Santal Blush Eau de Parfum
body: A textured fusion celebrating sandalwood, Santal Blush presents exotic spices enhanced with luxe ylang-ylang, warm cinnamon, and sumptuous woods—seducing with modern, second-skin warmth.

title: Soleil Neige Eau de Parfum Set with Travel Spray
body: Soleil Neige is a ray of solar light—a breath of winter air that conjures sun on fresh alpine snow. Radiant and exhilarating, it captivates with bright citrus, white florals and musk.

title: Black Orchid Eau de Parfum & Travel Spray Set
body: Black Orchid, a rare bloom born of the quest for the perfect flower. This luxe gift set features 50mL eau de parfum bottle and 10mL travel spray.

title: Ombré Leather Reserve Set
body:
The journey into the untamed landscape of the high desert begins with the mesmerizing beauty of the silver juniper ScentTrek™ — new to Reserve. The silver juniper grows high in the Chisos Mountains, its aromatic facets captured by headspace technology exclusively for TOM FORD. The scent evolves as sunlight touches the tree. It begins fresh and ultimately reveals its woody depth, anchored by myrrh undertones.

Cypress essence, new to the fragrance, introduces an aromatic and invigorating pine freshness. The note is joined with black pepper accord, a zesty-spicy scent with woody undertones to bring a captivating warmth to the desert air. The bright green floralcy of violet leaf absolute shines a sun-dappled light on the mountainous landscape.

title: Architecture Multi-Use Foundation Stick
body: This all-day foundation stick features a supremely soft, transformative texture that delicately glides on skin, then diffuses to a velvety, soft matte finish. The buildable formula features second-skin wear technology that delivers lightweight, comfortable and beautiful medium-to-full coverage throughout the day. Infused with hyaluronic acid microspheres, the formula delivers immediate hydration. It smoothly glides on skin without creasing or settling for 24 hours. Designed for ultimate versatility, the multi-use formula can be used for every step in the TOM FORD Architecture regimen: perfecting and blurring the skin, and sculpting and highlighting contours when used in deeper and lighter shades.

title: Runway Liquid Lip Color Matte
body:
Plush, liquid velvet. Runway Liquid Lip Color Matte cushions lips in unmatched comfort.

A powder-soft matte with undeniable shade impact, this formula immaculately adapts to your unique lip contours, resulting in a sensorial lip experience.

title: Reserve Lip Color
body: Artistry meets innovation in TOM FORD Reserve Lip Color, a high-impact lipstick.

title: Vanilla Sex Eye Color Quad
body:
Lightweight and pigment-rich, an array of enhanced shimmer and matte shades creates sensuous looks that can transform from daytime softness to evening drama in a blink. The formula’s enhanced light-diffusing pigments amplify the glimmering effect of sparkling powders and the sensorial softness.

Presented in 01 Metallust. The formula has been designed to deliver a silky texture, color fidelity and high sensoriality to create a polished, multidimensional finish.

title: Vanilla Sex Lip Color
body:
More desirable than ever, Lip Color is invigorated with a blend of meadowfoam seed and tsubaki oils, to hydrate and condition lips, helping to maintain the lip moisture barrier with their decadent emollience.
The formula, which also includes camelina and pomegranate seed oils, envelops lips in an ultra-creamy texture, allowing for seamless glide.

title: Ombré Leather Reserve
body:
The journey into the untamed landscape of the high desert begins with the mesmerizing beauty of the silver juniper ScentTrek™ — new to Reserve. The silver juniper grows high in the Chisos Mountains, its aromatic facets captured by headspace technology exclusively for TOM FORD. The scent evolves as sunlight touches the tree. It begins fresh and ultimately reveals its woody depth, anchored by myrrh undertones.

Cypress essence, new to the fragrance, introduces an aromatic and invigorating pine freshness. The note is joined with black pepper accord, a zesty-spicy scent with woody undertones to bring a captivating warmth to the desert air. The bright green floralcy of violet leaf absolute shines a sun-dappled light on the mountainous landscape.

title: TOM FORD Love Collection Lip Stylo Matte
body: Created with a specially designed blurred pigment technology, this rich formula instantly hydrates lips with each application.

title: TOM FORD Love Collection Soft Matte Blush
body: Infused with smoothing microsphere technology, this innovatively designed cream powder formula imparts a second-skin flush of sensorial color to skin. Dimensional pigments melt seamlessly into skin for natural-looking, diffused color. Cheeks are visibly enhanced with a smooth, buildable, blurred finish.

title: TOM FORD Love Collection Eye Color Duo Lumiére
body: The palette’s ribbon motif echoes the floral tones bonded in Rose Prick’s pink perfection. Eye Color Duo Lumière showcases hues that impeccably enhance eye shape in a single swipe. Highly micronized pearls diffuse light for a multi-dimensional effect that glimmers when hit by the light. This versatile formula can be used dry for a soft sheer finish or used wet for a sultry intensity.

title: Runway Lip Color Clutch Size
body:
More desirable than ever, Runway Lip Color is invigorated with a blend of meadowfoam seed and tsubaki oils, to hydrate and condition lips, helping to maintain the lip moisture barrier with their decadent emollience.
The formula, which also includes camelina and pomegranate seed oils, envelops lips in an ultra-creamy texture, allowing for seamless glide.

title: Shade and Illuminate Soft Radiance Primer Broad Spectrum SPF 25
body:
Infused with hyaluronic acid and a blend of moringa oil, passion fruit oil, and ginger extract, this sensorial, skincare-primer hybrid melts seamlessly into skin for a hydrated, smooth, and supple feel.
Can be used alone, or under Shade and Illuminate Soft Radiance Foundation SPF 50 for 12-hour luminosity.

title: Eau De Grey Vetiver Eau De Toilette
body:
Eau de Grey Vetiver embodies the modern grey suit – a lightweight, breathable air of citrus woody elegance.

Grapefruit and green bergamot notes layer over velvety iris threaded with the scent of artemisia. Clary sage – sourced from Provence – radiates verdant earthiness.

These ingredients bend and curve, line for line, around vetiver, revealing the ingredient’s duality: a woody freshness and a dried, earthy warmth. Amber-flecked woods and an oakmoss dimension accent a clean musk accord.

title: Private Blend Luxe Discovery Set
body: Discover iconic Private Blend scents designed for the true connoisseur.

title: Soleil Blanc Parfum
body: In the world of Soleil, the sun never sets. The heat of endless summer lingers on the skin and wears long into the night. Soleil Blanc Parfum is an exaltation of floral amber warmth with a rich concentration of white florals and glowing vanilla absolute.

title: Soleil Bronzing Powder
body: This silky bronzer melts into skin for a flawless, soft-focus warmth. The buildable formula can seamlessly create soft to bolder looks, for natural-looking to more defined contours. Formulated with microsphere powders that leave a cashmere-soft, matte finish for all-day wear.

title: Soleil Hydrating Lip Oil
body: A revitalizing gel-oil hybrid formula wraps lips in hydration with sensorial comfort. Infused with coconut oil and vitamin E, the unique formula drenches lips in shine and moisture to enhance and accentuate with a glossy shine. Scented with TOM FORD’s iconic coco de mer accord, Soleil Hydrating Lip Oil evokes the endless summer world of Soleil.

title: Soleil Eye Color Quad Lumière
body: Soleil Eye Color Quad Lumière showcases hues that impeccably enhance eye shape in a single swipe. Highly micronized pearls diffuse light for a multi-dimensional effect that glimmers when hit by the light. This versatile formula can be used dry for a soft sheer finish or used wet for a sultry intensity.

title: Soleil Glow Highlighter
body: This formula mimics the sun reflecting off water, capturing its luminous glow in the last minutes of golden hour. The long-wearing highlighter features ultrafine pearlescent pigments that seamlessly enhance the skin, imparting a sunlit iridescence. Each pearl is cushioned in gel technology for an ultra-smooth, diffused glow from every angle.

title: Soleil Sunkissed Blush
body: This weightless, whipped blush is buildable and blendable, creating an airy flush of natural summer color. The ultra-sensorial formula delivers a diffused, all-day flush.

title: Soleil Tinted Lip Glow
body: The sunset glow of golden hour inspires this gloss-meets-lip stain. The sumptuous formula features a pigmented oil that applies with a dual effect. Lips are cushioned with instant moisture and luminous shine. Over time, the gloss finish diffuses, imparting a kiss of tint, while leaving lips feeling moisturized. The diffused, transfer-resistant tint leaves lips looking instantly plumped. Infused with TOM FORD’s iconic coco de mer accord, the formula evokes the endless summer world of Soleil.

title: Soleil Blanc Hand & Body Moisturizer
body: Lightweight and fast absorbing, this emollient formula helps moisturize the skin instantly and all day long – and leaves hands and body feeling soft, smooth and scented with the floral amber fragrance of Soleil Blanc. Presented with an elevated pump dispenser for ultimate ease and to ensure maximum indulgence.

title: Soleil Blanc Hand & Body Wash
body: This refreshing clear gel yields to a sumptuous lather that gently, yet thoroughly cleanses. Skin is left feeling soft, smooth and refreshed – and scented with the amber Soleil Blanc fragrance. Presented with an elevated pump dispenser for ultimate ease and maximum indulgence.

title: Jasmin Rouge Eau de Parfum
body: Sensuous and saturated like TOM FORD’s iconic red Lip Colors, Jasmin Rouge unveils the flower's erotic decadence. An unexpected and voluptuous blend of precious jasmine sambac sepals absolute, dusk clary sage and peppercorn spices is as audacious as red, lacquered  lips.

title: Oud Wood Deodorant Stick
body:
With Oud Wood, TOM FORD uses rare oud notes to overwhelm the senses with dark, earthy sensuality. Exotic rosewood and cardamom give way to a smoky blend of precious oud notes, sandalwood and vetiver. Tonka bean and amber add warmth and sensuality.

Infused with the rare and distinct scent of oud wood, this deodorant stick provides fast-drying odor protection.

title: Lost Cherry and Soleil Blanc Duo Mini Set
body: Lost Cherry is audacious and iconic — a fruity amber scent glossed in a candy-like gleam. Soleil Blanc captures the warmth of endless summer with white florals, a pistachio note and the sultry coco de mer accord.

title: Figue Érotique Collection Eye Color Quad
body: Formulated with advanced color processes, the four finishes - sheer sparkle, satin, shimmer and matte - offer a spectrum of intensity and effects and deliver incredible shade fidelity.

title: Architecture Soft Matte Blush
body: Infused with smoothing microsphere technology, this innovatively designed cream powder formula imparts a second-skin flush of sensorial color to skin.

title: Taormina Orange Eau de Parfum
body: The journey to Taormina starts with an exhilarating Ionian breeze charged with teeming blood orange groves, and the crisp, bitter-tinged sweetness of orange bigarade oil. Earthy oakmoss and salt-skin musks entwine with citrus, grounding the fruit in an alfresco warmth.

title: Runway Eye Color Quad Crème
body:
The unmistakable TOM FORD T, as seen on iconic eyewear and accessories, is emblazoned on the Runway Eye Color Quad compacts. A gold-tone T indicates the Poudre formula, while matte brown signifies Crème.

The covetable, artistry-inspired palettes feature a flattened pan with increased shadow volume. Each pan is designed for optimal brush and applicator pickup.

title: Runway Lip Stylo Matte
body: A lip designed to command attention without saying a word. Created with a specially designed blurred pigment technology, this rich formula instantly hydrates lips with each application.

title: Runway Eye Color Quad Poudre
body: Lightweight and pigment-rich, an array of sparkle, shimmer, matte and demi-matte shades creates sensuous looks that can transform from daytime softness to evening drama in a blink. The formula’s enhanced light-diffusing pigments amplify the glimmering effect of sparkling powders and the sensorial softness. Presented in an artistry-inspired palette stamped with a gold-toned T.

title: Runway Eye Gloss
body:
This versatile formula applies with the ease of a gloss and delivers a lustrous, dewy glow to lids. The formula is used as the final touch to dress lids in a luminous sensuality. A tool for creating the ultimate runway gaze.
Avaliable in universal shade: 01 Clear

title: Architecture Brow Pencil
body: The TOM FORD Architecture Brow Pencil enhances facial dimension by defining brows with clear-cut precision. The structured shape of the pencil tip allows for hair-like strokes that create a custom-tailored brow look.

title: White Suede Hand Cream
body:
The White Suede Hand Cream is a silky, rich cream. Formulated with Camelina Oil and Meadowfoam Seed Oil, this formula pampers the hands. Hyaluronic Acid, Glycerin and a blend of three hydrating ingredients help moisturize dry skin and soften hands and cuticles. Helps to replenish moisture to skin after washing or sanitizing hands.
Skin is left feeling soft, conditioned, looking radiant and scented with the White Suede fragrance.

title: Reserve Lip Color Case
body:
Forged from a single, uninterrupted plane of aluminum, the cases are feats of artistry. Aluminum, selected for its strengthto-weight ratio, allows for sharp detailing and a distinctive feel in the hand—a sensation reserved for those who understand that true luxury is tactile. TOM FORD BEAUTY’s lipstick cases are unique and held to the precise perfection synonymous with TOM FORD.

Refillable by design, Reserve Lip Color champions enduring beauty—both in form and function. The mechanism inside is engineered for effortless refill.

title: Reserve Lip Color Refill
body: Reserve Lip Color debuts the Reserve oil blend, a complex formulated for TOM FORD. Pure shade pigments are crafted with specially developed gloss-enhancing technology to impart dimensional, color-rich radiance in a single swipe. The weightless, silk-like texture coats lips in all-day moisture. A true mark of seductive elegance, Reserve Lip Color is designed for the ultimate TOM FORD lip connoisseur. Each shade celebrates the world of TOM FORD, a dedication to one of the house’s iconic store locales.

title: Figue Érotique Collection Gilded Gloss
body: Encapsulated pigments break down on application, helping the color transform before the eyes. The lip gloss sweeps on golden, then shade-shifts into a soft and flattering rose-peach glow that shimmers with iridescence and achieves a subtle shine.

title: Figue Érotique Collection Lip Color Satin Matte
body:
The formula delivers creamy, lightweight and long-wearing satin matte color in a single stroke.

Infused with a precious blend of soja seed extract, rose fruit oil and murumuru butter, the formula moisturizes lips for a more voluptuous look.

A full-coverage lipstick with high-impact color.

16 Scarlet Rouge, a warm red

50 Adored, an orange red

52 Naked Rose, a brick red

title: Vanilla Sex All Over Body Spray
body:
Addictive by nature, desirable by design. Vanilla Sex spotlights a captivating interplay of deep and bright vanilla notes.
Featuring the exclusive Vanilla Tincture India accord, a bright and sensuous nuance of the iconic ingredient.

title: Electric Cherry All Over Body Spray
body: ELECTRIC CHERRY merges the lush tartness of Morello cherry notes with exhilarating ginger, while opulent jasmine sambac entices with a mesmerizing aroma. Ambrettolide introduces an alluring musk scent, releasing a warm breath that mingles with spicy pink peppercorn.

title: Eau d’Ombré Leather Eau de Toilette
body: Essences of fresh ginger, coriander and cardamom ignite a bold opening trail that captures a new day rising over the American West. Vanilla tincture stokes a glowing leather accord — a sensual flame grounded in a landscape of rich amber and honeyed woods.

title: Private Blend Deluxe Sample Set
body: Oud Wood, TOM FORD’s modern masterpiece, reinvents one of perfumery’s most precious ingredients in a blend of oud notes, rich woods and amber. Neroli Portofino recalls the Italian Riviera with bright citrus, white florals and warm amber tones.

title: Soleil Neige Eau de Parfum
body: Soleil Neige is a ray of solar light—a breath of winter air that conjures sun on fresh alpine snow. Radiant and exhilarating, it captivates with bright citrus, white florals and musk. TOM FORD’s winter world conjures the thrill of a day on the slopes that melts into the celebratory warmth of après-ski.

title: Figue Érotique Eau de Parfum
body:
Figue Érotique captures the arc of the fig, beginning with exhilarating green freshness and rising to the exquisite moment before a fig bursts, flooding the senses with the exclusive Kadota fig accord's resinous nectar. An uninhibited study of pleasure. A frisson of stimulating green facets and heated resins ignites TOM FORD's exclusive Kadota fig accord in sublime satisfaction to a new amber fruity dimension.

"This fragrance captures the arc of the fig, from fresh and green to plush and ripe – it has an inherent addiction. I was initially attracted to the Kadota fig, because of the mysteriousness of its color. This fig has a rawness and sensuality that is irresistible, but elevated; it is floral and fleshy. I love that figs only come once a year...you must wait for them.”
—Shyamala Maisondieu, Perfumer"

title: Figue Érotique Candle
body: An uninhibited study of pleasure. The irresistible pull of the fig lies in its secrecy: a fruit that dually reveals and conceals. A frisson of stimulating green facets and heated resins ignites TOM FORD’s exclusive Kadota fig accord in sublime satisfaction to a new amber fruity dimension.

title: Vanilla Sex Candle
body:
Addictive by nature, desirable by design. Vanilla Sex spotlights a captivating interplay of deep and bright vanilla notes.
Featuring the exclusive Vanilla Tincture India accord, a bright and sensuous nuance of the iconic ingredient.

title: Amber Intrigue Eau de Parfum
body: A violet accord meets the velvet-soft, woody signature of sandalwood oil. Vetiver oil shines with vibrant complexity, bringing forth woodiness and a touch of citrus freshness. Gilded amber accord wraps around smoky labdanum, while a captivating date accord seals the fragrance in a luminous glaze. The fragrance’s centerpiece is a prized and precious, cinnamon- inflected date accord. The date note, recalling the earthiness of honeyed fruits, brings forward a sumptuous smoothness. Sandalwood and vetiver oils become one in a woody nuance that is both warm and fresh. These woods venture into the background, meeting a hypnotic amber accord laced with labdanum.

title: Café Rose Eau de Parfum Set
body: The gift of Café Rose, a sensuous floral chypre scent of rose and dark coffee essences. This set features 50mL bottle and 10mL travel spray.

title: Mini Shimmering Body Oil Duo
body: Capture a sunlit luminosity with Soleil Shimmering Body Oils. These silky, lightweight all-over illuminator oils are infused with iconic Soleil scents and create a customizable glow. Presented in gift packaging.

title: Lip Color Mini Deluxe Set
body: Enhance lips with luminous, pigment-packed Lip Color in deluxe, clutch-sized lipstick cases. Presented in gift packaging.

title: Soleil Neige Eye Color Quad
body: Soleil Neige Eye Color Quad in 01 Chalet Mink showcases hues that impeccably enhance eye shape in a single swipe. The palette dresses lids in warm-toned vanilla, mid-toned pinks, and deep plum-cocoa for a lightweight, transitional smoky eye that glimmers with sunlit iridescence.

title: White Suede Eau de Parfum Set
body: The gift of White Suede. A wild, charming, musk-inspired scent featuring notes of saffron and velvety rose. This gift set features 50mL eau de parfum bottle and 10mL travel spray.

title: Ébène Fumé Eau de Parfum Set
body: The gift of Ébène Fumé. A meditative woody amber scent featuring notes of palo santo and rose. This gift set features 50mL eau de parfum bottle and 10mL travel spray.

title: Soleil Neige Crème Blush
body:
This buildable crème-to-powder formula leaves a dewy, winter-kissed sheen.

Presented in:

01 Alpine Blush, a mid-tone neutral pink

title: Oud Minérale Eau de Parfum Set
body: Oud Minérale merges rich oud notes with refreshing oceanic minerality. This set features 100mL bottle and 10mL travel spray.

title: Ombré Leather and Café Rose Discovery Set
body: Discover timeless Signature scents with modern impact: Ombré Leather, a warm floral leather; Café Rose, a floral chypre creation.

title: Neroli Portofino Deodorant Stick
body: Transportive and invigorating, Neroli Portofino captures the cool breezes, sparkling waters and lush foliage of the Italian Riviera — featuring crisp citrus oils, surprising floral notes and amber undertones to leave a splashy yet substantive impression.

title: Sunlit Rose Lip Balm Clutch Size
body: Sunlit Rose Lip Mini Balm hydrates while delivering a rosy hue that compliments your natural lip color. Available in exclusive clutch-size miniatures.

title: Noir Extreme All Over Body Spray
body: Noir Extreme All Over Body Spray is a refreshingly cool way to wear the amber woody scent inspired by the man beneath the bespoke suit. Layer over Noir Extreme Eau de Parfum or wear it on its own. Specially designed 360-spray technology allows for ergonomic application on neck, arms, legs and torso.

title: Shade and Illuminate Foundation Brush 2.5
body: The angled brush allows you to get into all the contours of the face and diffuse foundation evenly. The dense bristles ensure that foundation applies evenly and leaves creams and liquids seamlessly blended into the skin. This product also works to flawlessly apply Shade and Illuminate Soft Radiance Primer.

title: Azure Lime Eau de Parfum
body: A casually elegant scent that evolves with tasteful sophistication. This citrus chypre fragrance evokes relaxed, yet refined style with a lime water infusion accord, green aromatics, and sensual sandalwood.

title: Neroli Portofino Hand and Body Wash
body: This refreshing clear gel yields to a sumptuous lather that gently, yet thoroughly cleanses. Skin is left feeling soft, smooth and refreshed – and scented with the invigorating citrus floral Neroli Portofino fragrance. Presented with an elevated pump dispenser for ultimate ease and maximum indulgence.

title: Sunlit Rose Lip Balm
body: Sunlit Rose Lip Balm hydrates while delivering a rosy hue that compliments your natural lip color. Available in exclusive clutch-size miniatures.

title: Foundation Brush 02
body: Foundation Brush 02 is developed with synthetic hair, with a  handle designed for true comfort and balance.

title: Cherry Smoke Eau de Parfum
body: Cherry Smoke opens with the exquisite scent of dark cherry, enhanced by exotic saffron notes. The fragrant white flowers of osmanthus exude facets of apricot, olive, and leather—while a precious smoked wood accord tantalizes with heated vibrancy and a simmering, blazing pull.

title: Neroli Portofino All Over Body Spray
body:
Invigorating All Over Body Spray is lightly scented with Neroli Portofino, adding a new dimension and a refreshingly cool way to wear TOM FORD scent. Layer over your Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum or wear it on its own. With specially designed 360 spray technology, All Over Body Spray can be ergonomically sprayed sideways, upside down, and any which way on the neck, arms, legs, and torso. Formulated for a concentration perfect for all over the body.

Neroli Portofino is vibrant. Sparkling. Transportive. A fusion of crisp citrus oils with Tunisian neroli flower, the scent captures the cool breezes, sparkling water, and lush landscape that remind TOM FORD of the Italian Riviera.

title: Noir de Noir Eau de Parfum
body: A warm and sensual gourmand fragrance, Noir de Noir is TOM FORD's compellingly dark portrait of duality.  Rich, feminine florals collide with the masculine earthiness of black truffle, vanilla and patchouli.

title: Vanille Fatale Eau de Parfum
body: Vanille Fatale is an eclipse of dark woods, addictive coffee absolute and roasted barley. Luxe vanilla resinoid captivates at the fragrance’s core as an entrancing force.

title: Soleil Neige Lip Blush Clutch Size
body: This decadent, uniquely shade-shifting mini balm perfectly captures the gilded glow of Tom Ford Soleil with exclusive platinum flecks and packaging.

title: TOM FORD RESEARCH Cleansing Concentrate
body: This cleanser transforms from a tiny pearl to a luscious foam, rinsing clean, and leaving skin feeling refreshed and energized. Infused with hyaluronic acid, the formula is perfect for all skin types, including sensitive.

title: Rose Exposed Eau de Parfum
body:
This stunning scent of floral leather excellence premieres an exclusive rose-on-rose co-distillation note of rose absolute and rose water extract.

Precious blooms are bound in a spellbinding bouquet accented with white pepper, musk and woods.

title: Neroli Portofino Hand and Body Moisturizer
body: Lightweight and fast absorbing, this emollient formula helps moisturize the skin instantly and all day long* – and leaves hands and body feeling soft, smooth and scented with the citrus floral aroma of Neroli Portofino. Presented with an elevated pump dispenser for ultimate ease and to ensure maximum indulgence.

title: Oud Wood Parfum
body: Oud Wood Parfum reveals astounding new facets of the iconic Oud Wood fragrance. Natural essences of invigorating cardamom and patchouli bow to a rich blend of prized wood notes warmed by seductive vanilla, smoldering saffron, and tonka bean facets, with glowing amber resin accords.

title: Ébène Fumé Eau de Parfum
body: Mindfulness meets opulence in Ébène Fumé. The deeply meditative scent celebrates the mystical essence of Palo Santo smoke stoked by the warm elegance of cistus absolute, enticing black pepper absolute, and notes of ebony wood, captured in sleek, sublime notes of leather.

title: TOM FORD RESEARCH Intensive Treatment Lotion
body:
TOM FORD Research introduces Intensive Treatment Lotion, a luxurious, high-performance formula to instantly energize and help balance the complexion and visibly minimize pores*; leaving skin looking smoother, youthfully radiant, and prepared for the next steps in your regimen. Fast-absorbing with a sumptuous, watery texture, Intensive Treatment Lotion is powered by the TOM FORD Research signature power ingredients, rare White Porcelain Cacao, energizing Caffeine, and protective Gyokuro which help support and preserve skin’s natural energy. Skin looks rebalanced, recharged, and youthfully radiant.
*when used with Intensive Treatment Emulsion.

title: Oud Minérale Eau de Parfum
body: The warmth of oud is spiked with a wave of fresh pink peppercorn as fir balsam and ambergris balance earthy and marine inflections. A surge of smoky woods embraces sensual, skin-gripping musks for a contrasting fusion of elements.

title: Rose Prick Eau de Parfum
body: A pristine scent, Rose Prick's beauty stems from a wild bouquet of rare blooms inspired by the ones found in a private rose garden.  A patchouli note exhales the woody breath of chypre to the floral heart, while the warmth of roasted tonka smolders with notes of caramel and vanilla.

title: Lost Cherry Eau de Parfum
body: Lost Cherry mingles black cherry with cherry liqueur accords and a touch of bitter almond, bursting forth in waves of sweet and tart. Opulent floral notes of rose and jasmine sambac blend with an unexpected mélange of sandalwood, vetiver, and cedarwood.

title: Concealer Brush 03
body: Designed with synthetic hair, Concealer Brush 03 expertly glides product onto skin for precise application.

title: Soleil Summer Ultra-Shine Lip Color
body:
Soleil Ultra-Shine Lip Color embodies the effortless style and unapologetic luxury of an endless summer. Inspired by hues that recall escapist destinations. Features an even, glossy application and a lightweight, conditioned feel.
38 Nude Coast, a light beige
39 Pink Buff, a warm pink

title: Black Orchid Discovery Collection
body:
A complete collection. TOM FORD’s perfect flower in all its iterations. Experience four unique dimensions of Black Orchid, each scent a unique floral amber revelation.

This exclusive set features 1.5mL discovery sprays:

title: Grey Vetiver Parfum
body: With its elegant and refined heart of natural vetiver superbly blended with sun-drenched citrus, rich spices and prized woods, Grey Vetiver captures the essence of debonair, charismatic and provocative masculinity.

title: Oud Voyager Eau de Parfum
body:
Experience a journey through time where the past, present and future unite ancient oud with a futuristic floral. Oud Voyager is a scent odyssey that premieres the exclusive floral oud tri distillate — a bespoke creation that uniquely crafts enigmatic oud with two stellar florals: geranium and living red peony accord.

Fragrance Foundation Awards Winner: Fragrance of the Year - Ultra Luxury

“Oud Voyager features a beautiful quality of oud that has a woody, ambery effect, magnifying the ancient note’s enigmatic brilliance. It brings the iconic oud ingredient into the future through modern fragrance technology. The exclusive floral oud tri-distillate is a magic combination of florals and oud that captures the sense of hyper-saturated colors and mystical oud.” - Dominique Ropion, Master Perfumer

title: Ombré Leather Parfum
body:
A distinct floral leather capturing the American west, Ombré Leather Parfum magnifies the original fragrance, merging black leather accord with powerful violet leaf and sensual cedarwood laced with a hint of green tobacco notes.

TOM FORD has updated its packaging on select products. The formula and quantity of contents remain unchanged.

title: Fucking Fabulous Lip Color
body:
This ultra-sensorial solid lipstick with liquid-like glide. A single stroke melts onto lips for uncensored, unadulterated color and hydrating comfort.

Fucking Fabulous Lip is expressed in 10 shades that defy convention. Designed for uptown escapists to streetwear muses — artists and intellectuals — nightlife denizens and cultural provocateurs.

title: Runway Lip Color
body:
More desirable than ever, Runway Lip Color is invigorated with a blend of meadowfoam seed and tsubaki oils to hydrate and condition lips, helping to maintain the lip moisture barrier with their decadent emollience.

The formula, which also includes camelina and pomegranate seed oils envelops lips in an ultra-creamy texture, allowing for seamless glide.

title: Gloss Luxe
body: Gloss Luxe delivers light-as-air, sheer-to-medium coverage with a high-shine finish. Infused with nourishing oils (including jojoba seed and avocado), the luxe gloss hydrates lips and imparts a full-looking, nearly-naked gleam.

title: Cheek Brush 06
body: Developed with synthetic hair, Cheek Brush 06 allows for complete versatility. Layer color to desired intensity or sheer it down to transparency. The handle is designed for true comfort and balance.

title: Soleil Blanc All Over Body Spray
body: Lightly scented Soleil Blanc All Over Body Spray is a refreshingly cool way to wear the sultry floral amber fragrance. Layer over Soleil Blanc Eau de Parfum or wear it on its own. Specially designed 360-spray technology allows for ergonomic application on neck, arms, legs and torso.

title: Architecture Soft Matte Blurring Foundation
body: Sculpted softness. Blurred precision. This luxe, lightweight fluid formula applies seamlessly for a soft-matte finish and extended 24-hour wear. Soft-focus microsphere powders diffuse light and help control oil, while hyaluronic acid and powerful antioxidants nourish and protect skin.

title: Soleil Clutch Lip Set
body: Three highly coveted Soleil lip formulas in limited-edition clutch sizes. Soleil Lip Blush and Soleil Neige Lip Blush shade-shift from a clear glossiness to a personalized pink stain. Soleil Sunlit Rose Lip Balm hydrates and leaves a subtle pinky shine.

title: Eye Contour Brush 12
body: Developed with synthetic hair, Eye Contour Brush 12 is a perfect companion for Eye Color Quads. The handle is designed for true comfort and balance.

title: Neroli Portofino Parfum
body: Neroli Portofino Parfum captures an amplified dimension of bold citrus. A double concentration of neroli accord is heightened with the fresh vibrancy of Italian blood orange, opulent white florals and a sensual amber musk.

title: Grey Vetiver Eau de Parfum
body: With its elegant and refined heart of natural vetiver superbly blended with sun-drenched citrus, rich spices and prized woods, Grey Vetiver captures the essence of debonair, charismatic and provocative masculinity.

title: Noir Extreme Eau de Parfum
body:
A rich blend of warm spices and glowing citrus gives way to the scent of tantalizing kulfi and an array of floral notes — rose absolute accord, jasmine accord and orange flower. A woody, amber-drenched impact defines the finish, where a powerful amber dosage is studded with sandalwood and molten vanilla embers.

"Noir Extreme captures the daring, opulent side of the Noir man. He knows his desires, his vices, and what brings him pleasure and relishes in the indulgence of it. It is this private side he reserves for himself, at its maximum expression." — Sonia Constant, Perfumer

title: Fucking Fabulous All Over Body Spray
body: Lightly scented Fucking Fabulous All Over Body Spray is a refreshingly cool way to wear the Private Blend fragrance. Layer over Fucking Fabulous Eau de Parfum or wear it on its own. Specially designed 360-spray technology allows for ergonomic application on neck, arms, legs and torso.

title: Rose D'Amalfi Eau de Parfum
body: Evoking the sunlit sensuality of the Amalfi Coast, Rose D’Amalfi mingles spicy baies roses with almond-like heliotrope and an exquisite “rose-on-rose” distillation—eliciting a wave of captivating, softly sensuous, skin-on-skin sensations.

title: Soleil Neige Shimmering Body Oil
body: Soleil Neige mimics the serene shimmer of sun on snow and the cool reflection of winter sun that brightens with glacial light. This silky, lightweight oil smooths on for a conditioning, revitalizing experience. Helps condition skin for a radiant look. Features the cool, citrus floral musk scent.

title: Soleil de Feu Eau de Parfum
body: Inspired by bronze strokes of fiery sunset light, new Soleil de Feu captures a burnished sensuality with tuberose accord, warm ambers, and exotic sandalwood.

title: Emotionproof Eye Primer
body: Offered in one universal pink hue, the primer creates a smooth canvas for TOM FORD eyeshadows with enhanced color vibrancy. The advanced formula contains silica for a blurring, soft-focus effect and second-skin texture.

title: Costa Azzurra Parfum
body: Costa Azzurra Parfum breathes an air of freshness through crisp lemon, while the dense coastal forest is felt with magnified oakwood extract and cypress. Stunning cistus absolute and harmony of ambers are illuminated—capturing the spirit of private, unfettered luxury.

title: Bois Pacifique Eau de Parfum
body:
Bois Pacifique journeys to a feeling of endless freedom and vitality. Essence of cardamom recalls a sunlit radiance. Brilliant akigalawood™ spotlights the fresh, aromatic spice note of turmeric over a woody-spicy blend that instantly conjures a cool sensuality. One becomes lost in nature’s grandeur as the smooth, careening richness of olibanum essence and orris butter courses through the fragrance. Sandalwood, cedar and oakwood facets comprise the forest of Bois Pacifique – a staggering presence of majestic woods illuminated by streaks of awe-inspiring solar light that emanate from a promising horizon.

Fragrance Foundation Awards Winner: Fragrance of the Year – Men's Luxury

title: Black Lacquer Eau de Parfum
body:
The fragrance shines with two exclusive innovations in modern perfumery: an incandescent black lacquer accord that captures a smoky, dimensional opulence, and a Makassar ebony wood note that evokes aspects of leather and birch. Beneath the glossy surface blooms the irrepressible mystery of a dark peony accord.

Fragrance Foundation Awards Winner: Fragrance of the Year - Universal Luxury

title: Tobacco Vanille All Over Body Spray
body: Lightly scented Tobacco Vanille All Over Body Spray is a refreshingly cool way to wear the opulent woody tobacco fragrance. Layer over Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum or wear it on its own. Specially designed 360-spray technology allows for ergonomic application on neck, arms, legs and torso.

title: Tobacco Vanille Conditioning Beard Oil
body: The key to a well-kept beard, this formula conditions and softens with a lightweight blend of almond, jojoba, and grapeseed oils as well as vitamin E. Infused with the opulent woody tobacco scent of Tobacco Vanille.

title: Slim Lip Color Shine
body: Formulated with a combination of waxes and rich emollients for a thin film of high coverage, a silky, lightweight feel and vibrant look.

title: Extreme Mascara
body: A creamy formula combines darkest black carbon and lash-filling powders to transform lashes for optimal glamour and drama.

title: TOM FORD RESEARCH Crème Concentrate
body: This cream melts into skin, for a recharged look, while the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles is diminished. White porcelain cacao, caffeine and gyokuro help support skin's natural energy. This formula boosts skin radiance and hydration.

title: Eau de Soleil Blanc Eau de Toilette
body: The fragrance opens with an uplifting rush of citrus fruit, elevated with a savory pistachio accord and spicy cardamom. A transportive blend of tuberose, ylang ylang and orange blossom with a coco de mer accord brings a balancing warmth.

title: Fucking Fabulous Parfum
body:
A masterpiece, intensified. The parfum features an increased dosage of leather, the addition of fir balsam absolute and a new expression of roasted tonka bean.
Fresh green myrtle essence highlights the citrus and aromatic notes of bergamot, clary sage and lavender essence that vibrate with mesmerizing glamour. The stimulating freshness envelops an almond accord deepened by an earthy orris accord, as lavender absolute emboldens essences of angelica root and carrot seed, tightening the Parfum’s intoxicating grip. A magnified leather accord top-stitched with a cashmeran note warms tonka roasted absolute for a supple, skinon-skin sensuality as amber undertones embellish leather with glimmering sophistication.

title: Electric Cherry Eau de Parfum
body: ELECTRIC CHERRY merges the lush tartness of Morello cherry notes with exhilarating ginger, while opulent jasmine sambac entices with a mesmerizing aroma. Ambrettolide introduces an alluring musk scent, releasing a warm breath that mingles with spicy pink peppercorn.

title: Bitter Peach All Over Body Spray
body: Intoxicating notes of pêche de vigne and blood orange oil release the slick sweetness of Bitter Peach at its luscious peak. A sensual heart is revealed through rum-infused davana oil, while a surge of patchouli lures senses to the furthest reaches of inner sensuality and abandon.

title: Shade and Illuminate Concealer
body: Infused with hyaluronic acid, this crease-proof concealer moisturizes, visibly obscures redness, and reduces the look of undereye circles — creating a flawless base for TOM FORD foundation.

title: Ombré Leather Eau De Parfum
body: Dust on wind, skin on skin, the Ombré Leather fragrance evokes the desert heart of the west. The sensuality of rich black leather is texturized with patchouli and vetiver, while floral tones of jasmine sambac conjure wild desert beauty – and layers of amber and moss mimic the heat of rock and sand.

title: Oud Wood Conditioning Beard Oil
body: The key to a well-kept beard, this formula conditions and softens with a lightweight blend of almond, jojoba, and grapeseed oils as well as vitamin E. Infused with the compelling, iconic amber woody scent of Oud Wood.

title: Eyebrow Laminator
body: Eyebrow Laminator visibly shapes and sets brows without smudging or clumping to enhance the look of your face architecture.

title: Runway Gel Eyeliner
body: Inspired by the iconic TOM FORD smoky eye, Gel Eyeliner creates multi-dimensional looks, from soft, subtle definition to a sultry, graphic look. The creamy matte pencil is expressed in richly pigmented shades that impeccably glide on with seamless color.

title: Fucking Fabulous Eau de Parfum
body: Vibrant clary sage and fresh lavender command attention with aromatic foreplay. Bitter almond and notes of vanilla  infuse textural richness to the leather heart, intensified by floral orris accord. Tonka bean drives the scent as amber undertones and blonde woods accords reverberate with a warm glow.

title: Lost Cherry All Over Body Spray
body: Lost Cherry mingles black cherry with cherry liqueur and a touch of bitter almond, bursting forth in waves of sweet and tart. Opulent floral notes of rose and jasmine sambac blend with an unexpected mélange of sandalwood, vetiver, and cedar.

title: TOM FORD RESEARCH Serum Concentrate
body: The Serum Concentrate immediately jumpstarts tired-looking skin, helping it to absorb and retain moisture. The appearance of pores, lines and wrinkles is diminished while leaving skin looking radiant.

title: Oud Wood Hand and Body Wash
body: Oud Wood is TOM FORD’s visionary reinterpretation of perfumery's legendary story — a quest for the ultimate oud fragrance. This clear gel yields to a sumptuous lather that gently, yet thoroughly cleanses. Skin is left feeling soft, smooth and refreshed — and scented with the Oud Wood fragrance. Presented with an elevated pump dispenser for ultimate ease and maximum indulgence.

title: Brow Sculptor
body: Eyebrows are one of the most important elements of your face architecture. A groomed and shaped brow is the most powerful, non-invasive way to define and enhance facial features.

title: Velvet Orchid Eau de Parfum
body: Velvet Orchid lives in Black Orchid’s world of glamorous mystique, while exuding its own ultra-feminine essence. Lavished with shimmering freshness, honey, rum and a dramatic floral veil, a new character emerges: one that pulls, rather than pushes; elegantly refined and polished.

title: Bois Marocain Eau de Parfum
body: Bois Marocain features the darkly opulent essence of ancient trees. Known for a molten aroma as captivating as the abstract forms in its heartwood, the scent uncoils powerfully, facetted with the spicy freshness of pink peppercorn and cedarwood.

title: Fougère D'Argent Eau de Parfum
body: Fougère d'Argent merges impeccable decorum with provocative vision – where reality and fantasy comingle from the start. Mandarin and bergamot notes blend with a shimmering ginger scent, its vibrancy giving way to two French lavender notes – while woody akigalawood simmers with smooth refinement.

title: Ébène Fumé Candle
body: Mindfulness meets opulence in Ébène Fumé. The deeply meditative scent celebrates the mystical essence of Palo Santo smoke stoked by the warm elegance of cistus absolute, enticing black pepper absolute, and notes of ebony wood, captured in sleek, sublime notes of leather.

title: Soleil Lip Blush Clutch Size
body: A look of endless summer. This moisturizing, uniquely shade-shifting balm perfectly captures the gilded glow of Soleil with a 24-karat gold-infused formula and exclusive gold-tone packaging.

title: Ombré Leather All Over Body Spray
body: Lightly scented Ombré Leather All Over Body Spray is a refreshingly cool way to wear the spicy, floral leather fragrance. Layer over Ombré Leather Eau de Parfum or wear it on its own. Specially designed 360-spray technology allows for ergonomic application on neck, arms, legs and torso.

title: Traceless Soft Matte Concealer
body: The formula merges hydrating skincare ingredients with imperfection-blurring makeup technology. It features hyaluronic acid for instant and 12-hour hydration and vitamin E for antioxidant protection. Spherical powders ensure silky-smooth, seamless application for comfortable, non-drying wear.

title: Shade and Illuminate Brush 04
body: Developed with synthetic hair, Shade and Illuminate Brush 04 provides effortless application without creating streaks or lines. The handle is designed for true comfort and balance.

title: TOM FORD RESEARCH Intensive Treatment Emulsion
body: TOM FORD Research introduces Intensive Treatment Emulsion, a decadently rich, yet uniquely fluid formula providing immediate and lasting hydration to smooth, soothe, and help minimize visible redness – while helping to restore radiance and boosting skin’s moisture barrier, without leaving behind residue. Intensive Treatment Emulsion is powered by moisturizing Hyaluronic Acid and the TOM FORD Research signature ingredients, rare White Porcelain Cacao, energizing Caffeine, and protective Gyokuro; Skin is refreshed and recharged with youthful radiance.

title: TOM FORD RESEARCH Eye Repair Concentrate
body: Specifically designed for the thin, delicate eye area, the Eye Repair Concentrate formula instantly hydrates, and visibly lifts and smooths, diminishing the look of fine lines over time.

title: Tuscan Leather All Over Body Spray
body: Lightly scented Tuscan Leather All Over Body Spray is a refreshingly cool way to wear the Private Blend fragrance. Layer over Tuscan Leather Eau de Parfum or wear it on its own. Specially designed 360-spray technology allows for ergonomic application on neck, arms, legs and torso.

title: Rose Prick All Over Body Spray
body: Lightly scented Rose Prick All Over Body Spray is a refreshingly cool way to wear the pristine floral fragrance. Layer over Rose Prick Eau de Parfum or wear it on its own. Specially designed 360-spray technology allows for ergonomic application on neck, arms, legs and torso.

title: Eyeshadow Blend Brush 13
body: Developed with synthetic hair, Eyeshadow Blend Brush 13 softens and blurs any harsh color lines. The handle is designed for true comfort and balance.

title: Oud Wood Hand and Body Moisturizer
body: Lightweight and fast absorbing, this emollient formula helps moisturize the skin instantly and all day long – and leaves hands and body feeling soft, smooth and scented with the woody aroma of Oud Wood. Presented with an elevated pump dispenser for ultimate ease and maximum indulgence.

title: Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum
body: Transportive and invigorating, Neroli Portofino captures the cool breezes, sparkling waters and lush foliage of the Italian Riviera. This reinvention of a classic eau de cologne features crisp citrus oils, surprising floral notes and amber undertones to leave a splashy yet substantive impression.

title: Black Orchid Eau de Toilette
body:
Iconic. Elusive. Sparkling.

Exposing itself at first moment, Black Orchid Eau de Toilette is a distinctly different encounter. Experience the seductive breakthrough in a new light with its own olfactive journey. Long-lasting with a more open, immediate expression, the custom-grown TOM FORD Black Orchid instantly takes center stage, inviting you inside in a way never before experienced in the classic signature fragrance. The initial impression is explicitly pronounced with the sparkling, petal-rich tuberose revealing its full floralcy from the start.

title: Black Orchid All Over Body Spray
body: Lightly scented Black Orchid All Over Body Spray is a refreshingly cool way to wear the rich, iconic floral amber fragrance. Layer over Black Orchid Eau de Parfum or wear it on its own. Specially designed 360-spray technology allows for ergonomic application on neck, arms, legs and torso.

title: Black Orchid Parfum
body: Black Orchid Parfum amplifies the iconic sensuality of the original. Its aphrodisiac effect elevates the most elusive and darkest of flowers to powerfully seductive new heights—revealing a magnified signature of ylang ylang dipped in golden rum accords.

title: Black Orchid Eau de Parfum
body: Black Orchid Eau de Parfum opens with aphrodisiac black truffle and sparkling ylang ylang—touched with effervescent bergamot and bitter orange. Rum-soaked black plum surrounds the black orchid accord in golden sensuality, while woody patchouli and creamy vanilla wrap the orchid in rich warmth.

title: Bronzer Brush 05
body: Developed with synthetic hair, Bronzer Brush 05 can also be used as an all-over face-blending tool to create a seamless, radiant look after makeup is applied. The handle is designed for true comfort and balance.

title: Fucking Fabulous Candle
body: Vibrant clary sage and fresh lavender command attention with aromatic foreplay. Bitter almond and notes of vanilla infuse textural richness to the leather heart, intensified by floral orris accord. Tonka bean drives the scent as amber undertones and blonde woods accords reverberate with a warm glow.

title: Mandarino di Amalfi Eau de Parfum
body: Mandarino di Amalfi is an invitation into a Mediterranean idyll, where Italian coastal ingredients perfume the evening air. Tonic-like citrus, aromatic herbs, wildflowers and night-blooming flowers create a luminous, textured fragrance that is as blissful as retreating to a whitewashed Amalfi villa.

title: White Suede All Over Body Spray
body: White Suede All Over Body Spray is a refreshingly cool way to wear the Private Blend fragrance.

title: Lip Pencil
body:
TOM FORD Runway Lip Pencil defines and contours lips, and can be worn alone or with TOM FORD Runway Lip Color. The lightweight formula glides with ease for a clean, defined look. Expressed in eight new shades. Includes a TOM FORD sharpener.

Featuring a range of inclusive shades:

101 Close-Up
102 Re-See
103 Irresistible
104 Loves Attention
105 Private Client
106 A-List
107 Fire
108 Headline

title: Emotionproof Mascara
body: A combination of deep black pigments and a creamy texture work to help transform lashes with optimal glamour.

title: Café Rose Eau de Parfum
body: Essences of rose and dark coffee reveal sensual depth, while ylang ylang exudes an opulent floralcy. Coriander, patchouli and cardamom infuse a spicy warmth to incense resin and sandalwood accords.

title: Costa Azzurra Eau de Parfum
body: Costa Azzurra captures the uninhibited sensuality of a Mediterranean escape. The exhilarating aroma of sea air, fresh aromatic notes, evergreens and citrus set the scene and mingle with deeper woody scents—a crisp medley of cypress, oaks, and aromatics.

title: White Suede Eau de Parfum
body: White Suede is an elegant musk-inspired fragrance capturing the primal essence of these supple, sensual materials, giving them beautiful new dimension with a surprising musk medley heightened with velvety rose and warm amber notes.

title: Noir Extreme Parfum
body: Noir Extreme Parfum breathes a heightened concentration of spicy cardamom, spiked with the warmth of shimoga ginger and the rich sensuality of tonka bean and guaiacwood.

title: Black Orchid Reserve Parfum
body: A force of nature, TOM FORD's iconic Black Orchid in a deeper, darker chypre floral dimension. An increased dosage of ylang ylang adds new luminosity, its sparkling floralcy flecked with effervescent timut pepper. A blackened roasted tonka note smolders in the background while a black truffle accord exudes an elegant earthiness. The rich woody quality of patchouli mingles with amber tones. A study in the beauty of contrast — light and shadow discover they are one in this transformative fragrance.

title: Soleil Summer Spark Lip Balm Clutch Size
body: This multi-purpose, emollient lip formula can be worn on its own as a balm or as a primer under lipstick. Lightly scented with a luscious vanilla chamomile accord.

title: Soleil Lip Blush
body: A look of endless summer. This moisturizing, uniquely shade-shifting balm perfectly captures the gilded glow of Soleil with a 24-karat gold-infused formula and exclusive gold-tone packaging.

title: Lip Color Matte
body: Lip Color Matte creates a powerfully sophisticated look of unadulterated color, featuring a spectrum of richly pigmented hues from sensuous neutrals to alluring bolds.

title: Hyaluronic Energizing Mist
body: The unique blend of exclusive ingredients boosts hydration and leaves skin soft with a radiant glow - without adding shine. The multi-tasking formula may also be used with makeup to prime skin before application, as a finishing spray to set makeup or used throughout the day to refresh makeup and hydrate dry skin.

title: Bitter Peach Eau de Parfum
body: Notes of pêche de vigne and blood orange oil release the slick sweetness of Bitter Peach at its luscious peak. A sensual heart is revealed through rum-infused davana oil, while a surge of patchouli lures senses to the furthest reaches of inner sensuality and abandon.

title: Oud Wood Eau de Parfum
body: With Oud Wood, TOM FORD  uses rare oud notes to overwhelm the senses with dark, earthy sensuality. Exotic rosewood and cardamom give way to a smoky blend of precious oud notes, sandalwood and vetiver. Tonka bean and amber add warmth and sensuality.

title: Soleil Summer Lip Balm
body: This cushioning balm hydrates and protects lips with a hyaluronic acid-infused formula that provides immediate and long-term moisture. Soleil Lip Balm glides on smoothly with a sheer, subtle shine for instantly fuller-looking lips. Scented with the iconic coco de mer accord of the TOM FORD Soleil Blanc fragrance. This multi-purpose lip formula can be worn on its own as a balm or as a primer under lipstick. Lips enjoy a more supple, hydrated look and comfortable feel.

title: Eye Defining Pen
body: Formulated in the deepest shade of black, the Eye Defining Pen delivers ultimate precision. Create a spectrum of transforming effects, from classic, sleek lines to dramatic wing tips to a sultry doe eye.

title: Ébène Fumé All Over Body Spray
body: Ébène Fumé All Over Body Spray is a refreshingly cool way to wear the Private Blend fragrance.

title: Oud Wood Candle
body: A passion for rare, precious Oud Wood inspired TOM FORD’s pioneering composition of woods and spices.

title: Smokey Eye Brush 14
body: Developed with synthetic hair, Smokey Eye Brush 14 makes creating an eye look effortless. The handle is designed for true comfort and balance.

title: Tuscan Leather Eau de Parfum
body: Inspired by TOM FORD’s love of fine leather, this ultra-sexy interpretation captures the primal, animalistic scent of leather and its smooth voluptuous qualities. A modern classic, the addition of olibanum, night-blooming jasmine, and black suede gives it a distinctive, modern spin that is raw yet refined, sensual yet sophisticated.

title: Myrrhe Mystère Eau de Parfum
body: This seductive expression of the mystical resin elevates one of perfumery’s most iconic ingredients with a duo of powerful myrrh essences and an exquisite Ultra-Vanille accord, embodying a timeless richness – unlocking a modern serenity.

title: Oud Wood All Over Body Spray
body: Lightly scented Oud Wood All Over Body Spray is a refreshingly cool way to wear the Private Blend fragrance. Layer over Oud Wood Eau de Parfum or wear it on its own. Specially designed 360-spray technology allows for ergonomic application on neck, arms, legs and torso.

title: Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum
body: Tobacco Vanille is reminiscent of the very finest of private clubs – a classic fragrance infused with tonka bean, vanilla, cocoa, dry fruit accords and notes of sweet wood sap for a modern, opulent and heady impression.

title: Architecture Radiance Hydrating Foundation Broad Spectrum SPF 50+
body:
Liquid light in a weightless, serum-like formula. An exclusive blend of skincare actives: Queen of the Night – a soothing, night-blooming flower, niacinamide, hyaluronic acids and botanical oils helps to protect and strengthen the skin barrier. Dimensional light-diffusing powders create a soft, lit-from-within-look; SPF 50+ protects from the sun and maintains all-day sweat and humidity resistance. Skin is transformed and looks more radiant over time.

Disclaimer : Please be advised of a packaging error on this product. The shade name on the packaging for 1.5W Vanilla is incorrectly labeled as 1.5C Vanilla. The shade name on the packaging will eventually be updated to 1.5W Vanilla.

title: Ultra-Shine Lip Color
body: Soleil Ultra-Shine Lip Color embodies the effortless style and unapologetic luxury of an endless summer. Inspired by hues that recall iconic, escapist destinations.

title: Vanilla Sex Eau de Parfum
body:
Addictive by nature, desirable by design. Vanilla Sex spotlights a captivating interplay of deep and bright vanilla notes. Featuring the exclusive Vanilla Tincture India accord, a bright and sensuous nuance of the iconic ingredient.

Fragrance Foundation Awards 2024 Winner:  Fragrance of the Year Award — Universal Luxury.

title: Eyeshadow Brush 11
body: Developed with synthetic hair, Eyeshadow Brush 11 applies color with ease. The handle is designed for true comfort and balance.
